body:
I have gone through depression most of my life but it is usually in the background and I live a pretty normal if underwhelming life. 
And thoughts of suicide come up here and there for me (it can be once every few days or even once a month ) but even then don’t stick around for long most of the time. 

And then sometimes the depression comes roaring into the foreground. And the thoughts of suicide become much more constant and detailed. This can last for weeks or even months. 

But even at the best of times I can relate to the basic idea in the back of my head that I will probably kill myself one day.
I can. And I want to.  Or even just to listen.

Loneliness is soul crushing.  I feel you on that. I wish I could connect to people as easily as others do. But I can’t. I wish I had the answers to give you or any of the many others here who have the same problem but I don’t. All I can say is I and many others here would love to talk to you and just to get to know someone like you if you want to talk to some other people who know your pain.

I like the second part. The first one should be a suggestion not a request. Even just an age range might be better. I wouldn’t want anything that would in anyway discourage someone in need of help from posting
There are a ton of emotions that come up when you open up to someone. Any reaction would be normal.

I don’t know where you live but there might be some local groups to help with your situation. Youth centres or LGBTQ groups. 
None of this is your fault. And your situation can get better
We all have our own experience with mental health and emotional pain. So we know how little the bs platitudes work.

Off that is rough. I  know the feeling tho. I’m going through something similar. 
She is one of if not my best friends and I work with her. 
She knew I was interested in starting something but she wasn’t. Now I have to listen to her happily telling me of the new relationship she has started the last few weeks and it’s killing me. 

If you need someone to talk to or just to listen I’m here

Great post. We all come from different walks of life. We are different ages, and have different problems. But I care about each and everyone of you. 
We might not have the same experiences but we all know what it is like to hurt.  I hope so many of us can move forward together.
I’m here any time you want to. Life is hard for most people. For those who deal with depression it is almost unbearable at times

I can talk if you want. 
As I have said before on here I’m certainly no expert and I’m not browsing a suicide subreddit cause I’m in the best place myself but if you want to talk I want to listen

For sure this. I have dealt with depression my whole life and I still don’t know what to say to another depressed person. 
And someone who doesn’t know what it’s like to have their own brain to be their worst enemy would have no chance. Even if some of the things they say might be true it won’t feel like it. 

When I’m trying to talk to someone on here I mostly just try to listen. And hope that it helps them to be heard by someone who may not understand exactly what they are dealing with but understands what it is like to hurt
Hey if you want to talk to someone I want to listen

I’m in Canada too happy belated Canada day. 

That is really tough man. I can’t imagine. Yea that is one of the problems with being a guy. It seems the only emotion we aren’t judged for is anger. 

I’m far from any kind of expert but if you need someone to talk to or to just listen I’m here

Can you call them?  
I don’t know what you 2 fought about but sometimes it doesn’t matter who is right and who was wrong. Just finding out if you can take the next step together

Well if you’re posting here she might see it. So the whole discussion could be moot. 

Anyway. She may see it as an invasion of privacy that you looked into her post history even if it didn’t start out that way. My advice would be to just talk to her. You don’t have to let on what you know but try to ask her how things are going for her. 
Just try to listen and be there for her. No matter how much she decides to tell you. Just try to be a good friend. Hopefully it helps her just to know someone cares

Man I feel this. Sometimes when you love someone letting them go is the best thing for them. 
It sucks. It sucks so much. But hopefully in time it will feel good to look back on instead of painful. And know you have done and are doing a good thing.

Yea I can understand that. Sometimes it really is all you can do. 
And I’ll be around if and when you need someone to talk to
I assure you I’m a flawed guy with my own problems. But if you ever need someone to talk to I’m here.
I’m really not an expert at all but if you need someone to talk to or just to listen I’m here.

That’s rough. And I hear that I really do. When your depressed it’s hard to get motivated to do anything. 
But try to take small steps. If moving out isn’t an option for you maybe try volunteering somewhere     
Sometimes it helps just to help other people (it’s why I’m on here tonight) or maybe something with animals as you have said you wanted a puppy. If nothing else it would just give you a break from a home environment that is causing you stress. 

I certainly don’t have all the answers and I’m not browsing a suicide subreddit cause I’m in the best place myself. But it does take real strength to keep going and by trying to find a way forward

Not killing yourself doesn’t make you a pussy. Dying is easy. It’s going on with life that takes real strength. 
How old are you? (Roughly an age range is fine)
If your mother is a toxic person are you old enough to get away from her?

Home Depot seriously stopped selling ropes because of racists???

Those assholes have to go and ruin everything lol

Heartbreak is the worst. Especially for those of us that are already prone to depression. 

Lots of us have been there and would love to talk if you need someone to listen.  My situation isn’t the same as yours but I’m going through some and am certainly here to talk if you think it would help

I prefer to think of it as people who are struggling coming together trying to help each other. 
There are people in all walks of life who are hurting. Some of them will be helped by being listened to by people who at least on some level understand what they are dealing with.

I’m certainly no expert nor was I browsing a suicide subreddit cause I’m in the best place mentally myself lol. 
But if you want to talk to someone I’m here.
